titulo: What If All Water on Earth Froze in 1 Second? 🧊🌍
descripcion:
What would actually happen if every single drop of water on Earth turned to solid ice in just one second? 🧊🌍

Your body is 60% water, so your blood, brain and eyes would freeze solid instantly!

Ice takes up 9% more room than water—so the frozen oceans would swell about 300 meters upward, as tall as the Eiffel Tower!

A blinding white planet reflects most sunlight back into space, crashing the global average temperature to around -50°C.

And the craziest part? This actually happened 700 million years ago during Snowball Earth—until volcanoes pumped out enough CO₂ to melt the planet back!
